_about: NWIOI track catalog. Tier I · Core Program: a fixed package (99 CEUs + supervision for the credential + SAR). Tier II · À La Carte: individual courses, supervision and SAR. status 'approved' = shown to the public; 'draft' = preview only (signed-in admin or NWIOI_PREVIEW=1).

recommendation._note: If someone has already done at least this share of the credential's supervision target, they no longer need a full supervision package, so À La Carte is recommended.

payInFull._note: Pay in full: Core package tuition x (1 - rate), rounded to the cent. Not applied to additional coursework or À La Carte.

planningRate._note: Planning rate for additional NWIOI coursework beyond the 99 Core CEUs. Additional courses depend on current availability.

library.note: Additional NWIOI courses depend on current availability.
library._note: Set url to the NWIOI course library page (for example https://www.nwioi.com/challenges once confirmed).

scholarship.title: FIELD Growth Scholarship
scholarship.copy: NWIOI offers a discounted rate for people with marginalized and intersecting identities who are underrepresented in sex therapy, sexuality counseling, or sexuality education and are experiencing financial need.
scholarship._note: Award amounts and whether they combine with pay-in-full savings are decided by NWIOI through the scholarship process, not the calculator.

coreKnowledgeExample: For example, a human sexuality course or a training on sexual development.
